foundations.locator: Fuzzy sets, membership functions and logical operations
foundations.summary: Crisp membership is binary, while fuzzy membership permits intermediate grades. Membership describes degree of belonging, not a normalized random-outcome probability. Minimum and maximum are common AND and OR choices; alternatives exist.

inference.summary: Mamdani combines fuzzy consequent sets before defuzzification. Sugeno uses constant or input-dependent crisp consequents with weighted output aggregation. A singleton weighted average must not be equated automatically with an arbitrary area centroid.

membership.locator: gaussmf, trapmf, trimf, smf and zmf; documentation identifies itself as v0.3
membership.summary: Official API documents triangular/trapezoidal breakpoints, Gaussian center/spread, and S/Z membership generators. This evidence does not assert the latest installed library version.

simulation.locator: Antecedent/Consequent definitions; rules; ControlSystem and ControlSystemSimulation
simulation.summary: The official example separates input/output universes and membership functions, rules, controller construction and evaluation for supplied crisp inputs. No execution of this external example is claimed.
